first.rationale: Competitor entry pricing is creating an immediate, segment-specific loss of price-sensitive SMB demand, and inherited evidence supports targeted promotional pricing for acquisition and revenue lift. Run only a tightly targeted, time-bounded test while verifying its original evidence and guarding against discount-driven low-quality or low-retention revenue. Activation deterioration remains material, so verify the activation-messaging record as the leading alternative rather than assuming pricing resolves it.

final.rationale: Run a standard experiment of in-product activation messaging. Its archived result directly addresses the 6% activation decline and showed improved week-one engagement (+11%), activation (+6%), and 30-day retention (+1%), supporting sustainable rather than merely front-loaded revenue. Promotional pricing is rejected because its qualified-revenue lift came with a 12% 30-day retention decline, making it unsuitable for the primary objective.
